title: Ivo and the Regiment
author: Paloma Amberdale
blurb: Ivo Crane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
